platform: Rhautt Nexus / 瑞合数智枢纽
nonCompletionRule: This contract proves Redis boundary behavior by local deterministic checks only. It is not Redis HA, TLS, ACL, or staging smoke proof.

degradationPolicy.redisUnavailable: Business truth writes must continue against PostgreSQL/MongoDB/object storage/outbox when Redis is unavailable; cache reads must miss safely and call the source-of-truth service.
degradationPolicy.health: Redis is optional unless explicitly configured as required in deployment environment.
degradationPolicy.fallback: Cache miss or Redis error must return null/miss, not stale business truth.
degradationPolicy.iotBoundary: Redis must never store real-time IoT control commands; only lifecycle handoff task status is allowed.

requiredEvidenceBeforeProductionClaim: Redis staging smoke with configured REDIS_URL
Redis-backed session/rate-limit integration proof if enabled
Health/readiness behavior proof when Redis is required by environment
